jobs.description:
At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. The Creativity Apps team needs your help shaping the next generation of creative editing tools by working on state-of-the-art technologies to surprise and delight creative pros and enthusiasts alike. You’ll be working with the world-class teams behind Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, iMovie, and GarageBand to create next-generation tools for creators!

We're looking for a Performance Tooling Engineer to own the tooling and automated tests that keep our products fast, efficient, and correct. Your mission is to catch regressions before they ship, across latency, memory, power/thermals and functionality, by building the test harnesses, benchmarks, and CI infrastructure that make regressions visible, reproducible, and actionable. The systems you build will run continuously across our device fleet and become the safety net our engineering team relies on. If you enjoy turning "it feels slower" into a hard number on a dashboard with a bisected culprit commit, this is for you.

• 
Design, write, and maintain automated tests that detect performance regressions (latency, memory footprint, power consumption, etc.) and functional regressions.

• 
Build and operate CI pipelines and tooling that run these tests reliably across a fleet of hardware devices.

• 
Create dashboards, alerting, and triage tooling that surface regressions early and help engineers root-cause them quickly, e.g. automated bisection, historical trend tracking.

• 
Partner with cross-functional teams & leadership to define meaningful performance goals and acceptance criteria.

• 
Continuously improve test coverage, execution speed, flakiness, and the developer experience of running and interpreting tests.

• 
Very strong problem-solving and coding skills.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Experience building and maintaining CI systems.

• 
Solid understanding of performance measurement fundamentals: how to benchmark reliably, control for noise, and reason about latency, memory, and power/thermal metrics.

• 
Experience writing automated tests and the tooling/frameworks around them.

• 
Proven track record of integrating AI tools to enhance both personal productivity and team workflows.

• 
Experience developing for Apple platforms (iOS/macOS), with working knowledge of Swift.

• 
Familiarity with the Apple development toolchain: Xcode, Instruments, and related profiling and testing.

• 
Experience with GPU programming and image processing systems (Metal, OpenCL, CUDA or similar).

• 
Experience with regression testing across many hardware devices, e.g., device labs, device farms, or fleet-based test automation.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

As Marketing Manager, Nordics, you will be responsible for developing and executing the marketing strategy and annual marketing plan for one of our business channels across the Nordic region, in line with company objectives, regional priorities, and global strategy.

You will play a key role in accelerating business growth by identifying market opportunities, driving customer engagement, strengthening customer adoption, and delivering impactful marketing initiatives that support our commercial objectives.

Working closely with commercial, clinical, and regional marketing teams, you will translate customer insights into effective marketing programs that drive customer success and long-term business performance.

You will report to the Senior Marketing Manager, Nordics and be based in Copenhagen, with regular travel across the Nordic region.

Role expectations

Strategic Growth & Business Development

• Lead the strategic growth of your assigned business channel across the Nordics by identifying and executing high-impact growth opportunities in alignment with EMEA strategy and in close collaboration with the commercial organization and Senior Marketing Manager.

• Proactively represents the Nordic region and our customers by providing market insights, customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and business analytics to support new product development and global strategy.

• Identify local growth opportunities and champion initiatives that support business expansion beyond regional marketing plans.

• 
Focus on end-to-end excellence across products, services, and customer experiences while maintaining a broad market perspective and identifying future opportunities.

• 
Generate actionable customer, market, and competitive insights to shape commercial priorities and marketing investments.

Marketing Planning & Execution

• Develop and execute the annual marketing plan for the assigned business channel, ensuring alignment with commercial objectives, company strategy, regional priorities, and global direction.

• Lead and execute channel marketing initiatives, including congresses, summits, customer events, speaker programs, educational activities, marketing playbooks, digital campaigns, and customer engagement programs.

• Own the end-to-end planning and delivery of key initiatives by defining timelines, responsibilities, materials, agency deliverables, stakeholder briefings, field team alignment, attendance where relevant, and post-activity follow-up.

• Champion regional and central marketing programs locally in close collaboration with sales, clinical, and regional teams, ensuring activities are translated into clear and practical execution for the Nordic markets.

• Use analytics and insights, including campaign ROI, customer reimbursement trends, market dynamics, competitive activity, and customer feedback, to continuously optimize marketing performance and improve future activities.

• Support successful product launches, commercialization strategies, and customer adoption initiatives.

KOL & Customer Engagement

• 
Build and maintain strong relationships with KOLs, speakers, key customers, institutions, and professional associations across the Nordics.

• Partner with external stakeholders to deliver educational, scientific, and professional initiatives that strengthen customer engagement and thought leadership.

• Identify, brief, and support speakers and KOLs for congresses, educational programs, and customer-facing activities.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner closely with Commercial, Clinical, Finance, Education, Regional Marketing, and local country teams to ensure aligned execution and measurable business impact.

• Provide channel expertise, customer insights, campaign materials, messaging, and practical guidance to support successful local execution.

• 
Build stakeholder alignment across functions and markets to drive implementation of strategic initiatives.

Digital Marketing & Innovation

• Utilize digital communication platforms, marketing technologies, AI-enabled tools, automation solutions, and analytics platforms to deliver and optimize marketing activities.

• Deliver integrated omnichannel campaigns that enhance customer engagement throughout the customer journey building the future of Digital dentistry.

• Explore innovative approaches to customer engagement and continuously evaluate emerging marketing trends and leverage EMEA and global best practices

Training & Capability Building (consider erasing – repetition)

• Train and educate country stakeholders on relevant aspects of the business channel, customer journey, brand strategy, products, and marketing initiatives.

• Develop training materials and supporting collateral to enable effective execution across local teams and share best practices, customer insights, and market learnings to support continuous improvement across the Nordic organization.

What we're looking for

Experience

• 4+ years of relevant experience in B2B or healthcare marketing, preferably within the medical device, pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or Fast-Moving Consumer Healthcare (FMCH) industries.

• Demonstrated experience developing and implementing successful marketing strategies and campaigns.

• Experience working cross-functionally with commercial, clinical, and field-based teams.

• Experience managing agencies, events, and external partners.

• Proven ability to use data and insights to drive decision-making and business results.

• Hands-on experience with congress participation, event execution, agency coordination, customer-facing activities, digital campaigns, marketing materials, and follow-up processes.

Skills

• Strong strategic mindset and commercial acumen.

• Ability to identify growth opportunities and translate insights into actionable initiatives.

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

• Excellent project management and organizational capabilities.

• Ability to work independently and navigate a matrix organization.

• Comfortable balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution.

• Proactive problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.

• Results-oriented and customer-focused approach.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

**

Qualifications**

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, or a related discipline is required; a Master’s degree is considered an advantage.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and AI-enabled productivity tools.

• Fluent in English.

• Fluent in Danish or Swedish.

Turn strategy into identity. Translate business goals, positioning, and insights into strong creative concepts and tangible visual directions.

• 
Own the creative process. Take projects from early exploration and concept development through presentation, refinement, and final delivery.

• 
Present with conviction. Communicate the thinking behind your work, bring clients and teams along, and turn feedback into stronger creative outcomes. Plan, facilitate and drive brand workshops with clients and present directions, ideas, final delivery.

• 
Stay endlessly curious. Explore emerging AI tools, technologies, and creative workflows, and experiment with how they can expand what’s possible.

• 
Create together. Work alongside a multidisciplinary team of designers, strategists, developers, and other specialists to turn different perspectives into great work.

• 
Design across worlds. Work with a diverse mix of clients and industries from ambitious start-ups to global companies, and lifestyle brands to SaaS and technology businesses.

Job requirements

What we expect from you

• 
Kick-ass portfolio. A proven track record of successful branding projects, big and small, and the portfolio to back it up.

• 
Digital-first thinking. Experience building identities that live and breathe across websites, products, social, campaigns, and other digital experiences.

• 
Multidisciplinary. Comfortable working across disciplines, navigating ambiguity, moving quickly, taking ownership, and balancing creative ambition with the realities of delivery.

• 
Agency or freelance experience. Experience from an agency, studio, or freelance environment where you’ve worked across different clients, industries, and creative challenges.

• 
Ownership. Lead projects from concept to execution, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope

• 
Style agnostic. Comfortable moving between wildly different visual worlds and believe the idea and context should define the aesthetic. Not your personal style.

• 
Strategic thinker. Understand how business ambitions and brand strategy translate into meaningful creative directions and design decisions.

• 
Motion & interaction. Experience bringing identities to life through motion, animation, or interaction is a strong plus.

• 
Strong fundamentals. An exceptional eye for typography, composition, hierarchy, colour, and visual storytelling. And know when to break the rules.

The most important thing that we offer is an inspiring and ambitious work environment, with an emphasis on learning and developing, both personally and as a team. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, who will like to join our Tech team in Copenhagen!

We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer to join our Tech team in Copenhagen. Someone who's excited about where software development is heading and wants to help shape how we build with AI.

As a member of our Tech team, you'll be an essential part of developing digital products together with our clients and the team around you. Since we're an agency, we work with a wide range of clients, typically in focused sprints where we build new products or improve products we've built with them before. Our stack is TypeScript with Next.js and React at its core, extending into backend services, APIs and integrations as projects demand.

We're operating in a time of agentic engineering. AI agents are changing how software gets built, and we embrace that: we use agentic tools to ship faster and build AI-powered features into client products. At the same time, we know that reaching the quality we aim for means sticking to the fundamentals of good software development. Agents amplify good engineering, they don't replace it. We're looking for someone with strong fundamentals in architecture, code quality and judgment, who can put these new tools to work without compromising on craft.

We have an excellent team across our Copenhagen, Montreal, London and Toronto offices. We'll throw challenges at you, teach you new things, learn from you, and make sure we grow together toward our ambition of setting new and higher standards for the web.

Check out some of our work HERE.

Key tasks

Shape, build and improve digital products end to end, from frontend (Next.js/React) to backend services, APIs and integrations

• 
Inspire adoption of agentic engineering: use AI coding agents in daily work and share learnings and insights with a team that explores and grows together

• 
Build AI-powered features and agentic systems into client products, such as MCP/LLM integrations, automations and intelligent product experiences

• 
Take technical ownership on client projects: architecture decisions, technical direction, and quality

• 
Lead by example on good development practices and ways of working, across both technical and non-technical team members

• 
Stay ahead of new trends and bring them into the team so we keep delivering top services to our clients

• 
Support with tech knowledge and skills across Signifly's different teams

What we expect of you

• 
Solid experience as a full-stack developer in a similar senior position, and strong with modern TypeScript, Next.js/React and backend development (Node.js, APIs, databases)

• 
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic development (tools like Claude Code or similar) and real curiosity about pushing this frontier

Experience building AI-native APIs and product features is a big plus

You're good at understanding real-world client problems and proposing smart technical solutions to address them

jobs.occupation: Are you our new jewellery design intern?
jobs.description:
We are looking for a jewellery design intern to support us with design and production.

longvé is a dynamic and innovative jewellery start-up located in the heart of Copenhagen, near Kongens Nytorv. We offer a fresh digital approach to the jewellery industry, with our digital platform empowering customers to design their own jewellery. We offer the customers classic customisable designs, handcrafted quality and sustainable sourcing of recycled materials, all at a transparent and fair price. The company launched at the end of 2022.

We are currently seeking an intern jewellery designer. This is a unique opportunity to impact a newly launched brand, and get a steep learning curve, while working in a high-paced start-up environment, where we make sure to have fun.

Besides being enrolled in a study program within jewellery design, fashion design or something similar, the ideal candidate should have:

• Experience in Rhino software

• Knowledge of rendering in Keyshot is an advantage.

• Skilled in ideation and sketching.

• Responsibility to meet deadlines and take ownership of the project.

• Ability to work independently in a high-paced start-up environment.

• Willingness to be a part of something new and exciting.

**

What you will do:**

As an intern, you will help develop new jewellery styles and collections by sketching new designs, and drawing up designs in Rhino. You will also have the opportunity to work with our partners for translating the designs into the hands of our craftsmen, as well as preparing the right quality image material for frontline sales and marketing use.

What you get:

• Hands-on experience with building a new jewellery brand

• Insights into and experience with the start-up world

• Possibility to build up portfolio material

• Autonomous working schedule where you can influence ways of working

• Working closely with the founders and joining a team that values great energy, good humour and strong collaboration

The start date and length of the internship will be agreed with the selected candidate. The internship may lead to a potential job opportunity based on the fit, skills, and growth of the business.

We promise to give you hands-on experience as well as an exciting playground for you to test, develop and execute great ideas. If you find this an exciting opportunity, please send your CV and resume, with some examples you have done, and the style you like personally. Send to Katja Schjølin at katja@longve.com.

jobs.occupation: Project Engineer | North Aquaculture · Grindsted, Denmark
jobs.description:
We aim to strengthen our Engineering Department and are therefore seeking a Project Engineer. You will receive training in RAS (Recirculating Aquaculture System) design and engineering, including pressure loss calculations, pipe system dimensioning, quality control of mechanical equipment such as pumps and heaters/chillers, sizing of water treatment facilities, creation and coordination of drawings, P&ID’s, and other technical project documents.

As a Project Engineer, we are looking for a systematic, detail-oriented, and self-motivated individual who enjoys working on problem-solving. You will receive training and guidance, but we expect you to take initiative and take ownership of your daily tasks.

Main responsibilities:

• Create and maintain design & engineering deliverables throughout the project life cycle.

• Coordinate and evaluate technical documentation and system descriptions.

• Collaborate with our design, project and sales team

• Consult with customer, project group and subcontractors.

• Dimensioning and calculation of water treatment system, piping systems and RAS-equipment.

• The role will involve some traveling to our clients and RAS facilities.

Qualifications and experience:

• Ideally, a Bachelor’s degree or Technical education in mechanical, hydraulic or process engineering.

• Preferably 1-3 years of relevant work experience.

• You thrive working as part of a team but can also work independently.

• You are analytical and have problem-solving skills

• Fluent in English, both verbally and in writing.

• Experience from the landbased aquaculture industry is an advantage.

If you find this role interesting and have any questions, please feel free to contact Peter Schytt by phone [+45 21 80 77 82](

• Manage budgets and financial performance for your projects.

• Encourage professional growth and knowledge sharing.

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited university

• Fluency in Danish is a big plus

The Aarhus Institute of Advanced Studies (AIAS) is pleased to announce an exclusive fellowship opportunity for a researcher who holds a position at a Swedish research institution. Why apply for an AIAS-RJ Fellowship

AIAS is a haven for intellectual exploration, hosting excellent researchers eager to develop their work in an interdisciplinary, international and collaborative environment. AIAS nurtures an innovative atmosphere where breakthroughs emerge through transparent, inclusive and reflective discussions, offering a space for engagement and creativity.

The AIAS-RJ fellowship gives the selected fellow the opportunity to concentrate on their own research interests while also being an active member of the AIAS research community and participating in and contributing to seminars and activities beyond their own field of expertise. The fellow must be eager to engage in the interdisciplinary community at AIAS and expand research collaborations with colleagues at Aarhus University.

Who can apply for an AIAS-RJ Fellowship

The call is open to curiosity-driven researchers who:

• are of any nationality who hold a tenured position at a Swedish research institution

• work within the humanities and social sciences

• have a research experience of minimum 4 years after completion of the PhD

A unique interdisciplinary platform at AIAS

AIAS fosters connections, sparks ideas and dissolves boundaries as fellows engage with researchers from different disciplines within the Institute and across departments and research hubs at Aarhus University. Therefore, the call welcomes applications from all research areas and themes.

With a location within the unique campus of Aarhus University, AIAS functions as an interdisciplinary platform that connects researchers across Aarhus University and international scholars. AIAS has fellows who work in thematic groups or in individual fellowships, and hosts events and activities, which AIAS-RJ fellows are welcome to join and contribute to.

AIAS and Aarhus University strive to create a multidisciplinary, inclusive academic environment and to be an inspiring workplace for all by fostering a culture in which the individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The fellowship includes

The AIAS-RJ Fellow is offered:

• a salary based on seniority (employment conditions and wages are regulated through the Danish collective union agreements)

• travel costs to and from Aarhus

• relocation assistance

• a moderate budget for research-related costs

The AIAS-RJ Fellow will have office space at AIAS and can participate in academic training activities, conferences and workshops at AIAS. They will also be affiliated with the relevant research environments at Aarhus University.

Applications must be submitted online via the system: GrantOne.

In the ‘Guide for Applicants,’ you can find the detailed application requirements and more information on the structure of the application system, the selection criteria and the selection process.

Timeline of the application process

As an 'Institute for Advanced Study,' AIAS brings researchers together across disciplines, seniority and nationality. AIAS offers fellowships for excellent researchers from all academic disciplines to pursue cutting-edge research projects for the benefit of society and humankind in optimal research conditions.

The daily encounter with colleagues from diverse research disciplines at AIAS provides fellows with fresh and different insights, methods and perspectives on their own research, leading to new and unexpected research questions and ideas.

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping the financial sector turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities & technologies

You will become part of a team that enables our customers to develop and manage their businesses through data and insights, working at the intersection of technology and finance. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data. To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in financial data management.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• 
Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.

• 
Structuring and collection of data from various sources.

• 
Implementation of financial business logic on data for use in reporting.

• 
Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.

• 
Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.

About you

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within finance and data management, probably from a bank, an asset manager or similar. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex financial data and challenges. You thrive in an environment focused on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:

• 
ETL and Database technologies.

• 
Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.

• 
Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

• 
The financial sector, including regulatory reporting in the banking sector.

Join an inclusive community
